# Melanated In Tech

> Melanated In Tech is an AI implementation company that improves costly workflows through automation, systems integration, controlled AI agents, document processing, and governed knowledge systems. Higher education is a flagship industry; practical tools and learning resources support the implementation work.

## Core Public Pages

- [Home](https://melanatedintech.com/)
- [AI Tool Library](https://melanatedintech.com/ai-tools): curated catalog of 60+ production AI tools with pricing, self-hosting, enterprise compliance, and MIT recommendation scores.
- [Head-to-Head AI Comparisons](https://melanatedintech.com/compare): technical side-by-side benchmarks and trade-off analysis between competing AI tools.
- [AI Stack Builder](https://melanatedintech.com/ai-stack-builder): interactive architecture wizard recommending full-stack AI combinations (model + orchestration + database + UI).
- [Problem-First AI Solutions](https://melanatedintech.com/solutions): pre-architected blueprints for customer support, document extraction, lead routing, and academic operations.
- [Higher Education AI Hub](https://melanatedintech.com/ai-tools/higher-education): FERPA-compliant, ethical AI tools for university admissions, student retention, and institutional workflows.
- [Implementation Services](https://melanatedintech.com/work-with-us): strategy, controlled pilots, production integrations, and managed automation operations.
- [Higher Education Services](https://melanatedintech.com/industries/higher-education): practical AI automation and integration for college and university administrative workflows.
- [Strategy Sprint](https://melanatedintech.com/strategy-sprint): fixed-scope workflow opportunity, ROI, risk, and implementation planning.
- [Proof](https://melanatedintech.com/proof): proof standards and clearly labeled reference workflows; reference designs are not client-result claims.
- [Knowledge Hub](https://melanatedintech.com/knowledge): practical AI agent playbooks, checklists, field guides, scorecards, and operating templates.
- [Agent Marketplace](https://melanatedintech.com/agents): production-oriented AI agent listings and packs.
- [Learning Paths](https://melanatedintech.com/paths): guided paths that connect articles, agents, tools, and products.
- [Interactive AI Tools](https://melanatedintech.com/tools): 22 free interactive AI tools (see below).
- [Products](https://melanatedintech.com/products): AI agent starter kits, prompt libraries, SOPs, and blueprints.
- [Services](https://melanatedintech.com/work-with-us): AI consulting and implementation engagement options.
- [Community](https://melanatedintech.com/community): discussion and shared learning for AI agent builders.
- [AI Fit Finder](https://melanatedintech.com/fit-finder): guided quiz recommending the right agent or product for your use case.
- [LeadFlow Revenue Audit](https://melanatedintech.com/diagnostic): instant email qualification, TLD validation, and revenue recovery diagnostic.

## Interactive AI Tools

- [Prompt Pilot](https://melanatedintech.com/tools/prompt-pilot): system prompt composer for AI agents.
- [GPT Trainer](https://melanatedintech.com/tools/gpt-trainer): custom GPT instruction builder.
- [Model Playground](https://melanatedintech.com/tools/model-playground): compare model capabilities side-by-side.
- [Agent Architect](https://melanatedintech.com/tools/agent-architect): multi-agent workflow designer.
- [AI Playbook Generator](https://melanatedintech.com/tools/ai-playbook): niche-specific AI implementation playbooks.
- [MCP Builder](https://melanatedintech.com/tools/mcp-builder): Model Context Protocol server generator.
- [Eval Studio](https://melanatedintech.com/tools/eval-studio): golden-set evaluation builder for AI outputs.
- [ROI Calculator](https://melanatedintech.com/tools/roi-calculator): AI token cost and business ROI estimator.
- [Token Cost Estimator](https://melanatedintech.com/tools/token-cost-calculator): live OpenRouter AI model token cost comparison.
- [Revenue Leak Calculator](https://melanatedintech.com/tools/revenue-leak-calculator): estimate missed leads and lost revenue for service businesses.
- [AI Readiness Assessment](https://melanatedintech.com/tools/ai-readiness-assessment): score team infrastructure, security, and AI workflow maturity.
- [JSON Schema Studio](https://melanatedintech.com/tools/json-schema-studio): visual JSON schema builder for structured LLM function calling.
- [Multi-Agent Calculator](https://melanatedintech.com/tools/multi-agent-calculator): compute token overhead and latency for multi-agent graphs.
- [Prompt Guard Auditor](https://melanatedintech.com/tools/prompt-guard-auditor): test system prompts against injection and leak vectors.
- [Workflow Spec Builder](https://melanatedintech.com/tools/workflow-spec-builder): convert business requirements into agent execution specs.
- [Agent Sandbox](https://melanatedintech.com/tools/agent-sandbox): isolated environment for testing tool calls and agent responses.
- [SOP Generator](https://melanatedintech.com/tools/sop-generator): standard operating procedure generator for AI workflows.
- [Policy Generator](https://melanatedintech.com/tools/policy-generator): AI usage policy builder for organizations.
- [A/B Tester](https://melanatedintech.com/tools/ab-tester): prompt A/B testing and comparison tool.
- [RAG Chunker](https://melanatedintech.com/tools/rag-chunker): document chunking strategy visualizer for RAG pipelines.
- [Voice Agent Builder](https://melanatedintech.com/tools/voice-agent-builder): real-time voice agent prompt & latency designer.

## Professional Services

- [AI Workflow Automation](https://melanatedintech.com/services/workflow-automation): controlled automation for repeated operational work and handoffs.
- [AI and Software Integrations](https://melanatedintech.com/services/ai-integrations): connect AI to CRMs, forms, email, databases, document platforms, and internal systems.
- [Document and Intake Automation](https://melanatedintech.com/services/document-intake-automation): classify, extract, validate, and route forms, email, PDFs, and uploaded documents.
- [AI Agent Development](https://melanatedintech.com/services/ai-agents): focused agents with approved context, tools, evaluation, and human boundaries.
- [Internal Knowledge Systems](https://melanatedintech.com/services/internal-knowledge-systems): source-aware search and governed answers across internal documents.
- [Strategy Sprint](https://melanatedintech.com/strategy-sprint): two-week workflow opportunity and ROI engagement.

## Main Knowledge Tracks

- Build: first agents, workflow selection, agent briefs, MCP, RAG, local AI, and prompt systems.
- Operate: evals, golden sets, logging, cost control, reliability, approvals, and weekly review rhythms.
- Secure: prompt injection, MCP permissions, human-in-the-loop patterns, data boundaries, and tool safety.
- Decide: ROI, buy-vs-build, vendor scorecards, readiness, and business cases.
